rrfs.label: RRFS extended
rrfs.about: NOAA Rapid Refresh Forecast System, 2.5 km
rrfs.schedule: NOAA's new convection-allowing model, 2.5 km over Hawaii. 00/06/12/18Z runs go out 84 h (the 'extended' runs); the others go out 18 h. Every 3 h in today's pre-operational feed, hourly once operational on 14 Oct 2026.

nbm.label: NBM
nbm.about: National Blend of Models (calibrated blend), 2.5 km
nbm.schedule: National Blend of Models: a calibrated blend of many models, 2.5 km, a new run every hour. Continues after the RRFS change.

refs.label: REFS
refs.about: RRFS ensemble (REFS) products: mean, spread (1 standard deviation), chance of 20/30/35/40 kt
refs.schedule: Ensemble products built from the current and 6 h older RRFS runs plus the RRFS ensemble members; every 6 h (00/06/12/18Z), hourly out to 60 h, 2.5 km.

rrfs_ens.label: RRFS members
rrfs_ens.about: RRFS ensemble members counted per area
rrfs_ens.schedule: The five RRFS ensemble members of the latest 00/06/12/18Z run and of the run 6 h before, plus the deterministic RRFS: the share whose area-average wind reaches each threshold. Every 3 h to 60 h.

uh_wrf.label: UH WRF
uh_wrf.about: University of Hawaii WRF via PacIOOS (no gusts)
uh_wrf.schedule: University of Hawaii WRF (run at UH, not NCEP, so not affected by the RRFS change): one run a day, 7 days; PacIOOS posts it about a day late. 2 km Maui-Oahu nest where an area fits in it, 6 km statewide otherwise. No gusts.

nws.label: NWS
nws.about: NWS Honolulu gridded forecast at each area's reference point
nws.schedule: NWS Honolulu's gridded forecast, the grid the zone and point forecasts are written from; updated whenever forecasters issue (at least twice a day).
